entries.name: Disperser
entries.transcript: Disperser, Active, Suppress. Disbells both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for 4 seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movement speed and 40% slow resistance for 4 seconds. The caster always receives the ally benefit on cast. The movement speed reduction and increase both starred at 100% and gradually decreased to 0% over the buff duration. Dispel type, basic dispel. Passive, mana break. Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per mana burned. Illusions do not burn mana.
